title: 第一卷 第5章 仙子姐姐你总算来救我了第一卷 第6章 真是个单纯又善良的女孩
content_zh:
“小人就是个小小杂役，不懂这炼丹之道，仙子姐姐为何炸炉，实在是不知啊……”
陈玄只好装糊涂。
“不知？”黄裙女子眼神一冷，“我看就是你这贱奴没有好好翻地，导致灵药长势不好，影响了本仙子炼丹！”
陈玄脖子一凉，明晃晃的剑又搭上肩膀。
他欲哭无泪，“这……实在是冤枉啊！我才锄地不足一月，可灵药半年生一茬，栽种现在这些灵药时，我都还没来飞仙门！”
这帮仙子怎么一个比一个不讲道理，自己炼丹技术差也就罢了，这也能怪到他头上？
还动不动就拔剑！
“你意思是本仙子很蠢？”黄裙女子脸色阴沉。
这个该死的杂役奴才，居然敢当众反驳本仙子！
陈玄两眼一黑。
还真特娘是小仙女！
“小人绝无此意……”陈玄跪在地上，冷汗直冒。
不等黄裙女子说话，张头儿率先跑过来一脚踹在陈玄肚子上，将他踹倒在地，压上去就是一阵拳打脚踢。
“好你个狗崽子，居然敢破坏灵药，肯定是你觉着干活太累，故意破坏药田宣泄愤怒，害仙子炼丹不成，你个杀千刀的，看我不打死你！”张头儿骂骂咧咧。
陈玄不敢反抗，只能蜷缩在地上，尽量用双臂护住脸，任由暴风骤雨般的拳头落在身上。
直到陈玄缩在地上不动弹，张头儿才停手甩了甩胳膊，转身跑到黄裙女子面前，谄媚道，“仙子请放心，我这就把这小子丢到乱坟岗，翻地的活儿找个老实的来做，以后绝不会出岔子。”
出了事总要有人担着，张头儿不可能将自己置身险地，便只能把陈玄推出去。
要说他的生死，又有什么关系呢？杂役院哪个不是提着脑袋过日子。
“也好。”黄裙女子满意点头，“要是以后再出这种事，我看你这杂役院管事也不用做了！”
“是……是！”张头儿点头哈腰。

陈玄一听两人就这样判了他死刑，顾不上疼痛仓皇爬起来，对着黄裙女子咣咣磕头，“冤枉啊，给我一百个胆子我也不敢做这种事，仙子慧眼如炬，定然能查明真相还我个清白！”
脸面什么的见鬼去吧！
“你这个贱奴说话还蛮中听。”
黄裙女子露出笑意，弯下腰看着陈玄，“实话告诉你，药田有没有出事我才不关心，但是炼丹失败让本仙子很不开心，来这儿就是想寻个乐子，能选中你是你的荣幸！”
陈玄心头升起一股寒意。
这就是仙人的行事风格吗，难怪那些人对这些仙人唯唯诺诺……比起面前这个黄裙女子，先前中了毒的那个仙子，可真是人美心善。
“把他给我丢到乱坟岗！”张头儿一挥手。
立马就有两人一左一右架起陈玄。
张头儿又吩咐道，“记得带到山下再动手，免得脏了仙子的眼睛。”
两人应了一声，拖着陈玄往外走。
恰在这时，一道靓丽的身影落在杂役院门口，快步朝人群走来，“你们不好好干活，聚在这儿干嘛呢？”
围观杂役纷纷回头，看到这位身穿靛蓝色轻纱道衣的仙子，急忙互相推搡着让出一条路。
道衣仙子穿过人群，看到了黄裙女子，疑惑道，“苏师妹，你怎么在这儿？”
content_en:
"The villain is just a little handyman who doesn't understand the art of alchemy. I really don't know why Sister Fairy blew up the furnace..."
Chen Xuan had to pretend to be confused.
"I don't know?" The woman in the yellow dress had a cold look in her eyes, "I think it's because you, a cheap slave, didn't plow the ground properly, which caused the elixir to grow poorly and affected my elixir refining!"
Chen Xuan's neck felt cold, and the shining sword was placed on his shoulder again.
He was about to cry but had no tears, "This... is really unjust! I have only been hoeing the ground for less than a month, but the elixirs grow every six months. When I planted these elixirs now, I had not even come to Feixianmen!"
How come these fairies are more unreasonable than the others? It’s just that their alchemy skills are poor. Can this be blamed on him?
He still draws his sword at every turn!
"You mean this fairy is stupid?" The woman in the yellow dress looked gloomy.
This damn handyman actually dares to refute this fairy in public!
Chen Xuan's eyes darkened.
She is really a little fairy!
"This villain has no such intention..." Chen Xuan knelt on the ground, sweating profusely.
Before the woman in the yellow skirt could say anything, Zhang Tou'er ran over and kicked Chen Xuan in the stomach, knocking him to the ground and hitting him with punches and kicks.
"You little brat, you dare to destroy the elixir. You must have felt too tired from work, and deliberately destroyed the medicine field to vent your anger, causing the fairy to fail to make the elixir. You are a murderer, let's see if I don't beat you to death!" Zhang Tou'er cursed.
Chen Xuan did not dare to resist, so he could only curl up on the ground, cover his face with his arms as much as possible, and let the storm of fists fall on him.
It wasn't until Chen Xuan huddled on the ground that he didn't move, Zhang Tou'er stopped and shook his arms, turned around and ran to the woman in the yellow skirt, flatteringly saying, "Fairy, please don't worry, I will throw this kid into a graveyard right now, and find an honest person to do the digging. He will never make any mistakes in the future."
Someone has to take the responsibility if something goes wrong. It's impossible for Mr. Zhang to put himself in danger, so he can only push Chen Xuan out.
What does it matter about his life and death? There is no one in the service yard who does not live with his head in his hands.
"That's fine." The woman in the yellow dress nodded with satisfaction, "If something like this happens again in the future, I think you don't need to be the steward of the mercenary courtyard!"
"Yes...yes!" Zhang Tou'er nodded and bowed.
When Chen Xuan heard that they had sentenced him to death, he hurriedly got up without caring about the pain, and kowtowed to the woman in the yellow dress, "It's unjust. Give me a hundred courages and I wouldn't dare to do such a thing. The fairy has a sharp eye and will surely find out the truth and clear my name!"
To hell with your face and all that!
"What you say, a bitch like you, is quite pleasant."
The woman in the yellow dress smiled and bent down to look at Chen Xuan, "To tell you the truth, I don't care if something happens to the medicine field, but the failure of the alchemy made me very unhappy. I came here just to have fun. It's your honor to choose you!"
Chen Xuan felt a chill in his heart.
Is this the way immortals behave? No wonder those people are submissive to these immortals... Compared to the woman in the yellow dress in front of her, the fairy who was poisoned earlier is really kind-hearted.
"Throw him to a mass grave!" Zhang Tou'er waved his hand.
Immediately, two people set up Chen Xuan, one on the left and the other on the right.
Zhang Tou'er then ordered, "Remember to take it down the mountain before doing anything, so as not to dirty the fairy's eyes."
The two of them responded and dragged Chen Xuan out.
Just at this moment, a beautiful figure landed at the door of the courtyard and walked quickly towards the crowd, "If you don't work hard, why are you gathering here?"
The onlookers turned around and saw the fairy in indigo gauze robes, and hurriedly pushed each other to make way.
Fairy Daoyi passed through the crowd and saw the woman in the yellow skirt, and asked doubtfully, "Junior sister Su, why are you here?"
